title: Which national team will win the first UEFA Nations League match between the Republic of Ireland and Israel in September 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : UEFA's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the first Nations League match between these teams in September 2026. 
  Resolution : Resolve when the match finishes, using the final score. If neither team wins, resolve to a draw. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning national team's name, or the result designation if the match is drawn.
